messages:
ade: quick q - should the fanout scorer be compiled into the policy or loaded at runtime? tradeoffs?
chris: compiled -> faster eval, harder hot-reload/rollout. runtime -> flexible, higher per-request cost unless shared.
mari: concrete numbers: python runtime scorer warmup ~30-40ms, compiled C++ scorer ~4-6ms. memory also differs.
piotr: compiled scorers share lookup tables. runtime per-tenant instances can blow RAM if unchecked.
ade: runtime gives tenant overrides & feature flags. idea: hybrid: compiled scorer graph + small hot-reloadable adapters for tenant overrides.
samir: propose API: ScorerAdapter(name, evaluate_fn, lifecycle={shared, tenant, request}). adapters bind to compiled scorer by stable id.
mari: need cache invalidation for KV/prefix caches when adapter logic changes. avoid silent regressions.
piotr: include adapter fingerprint (code+config hash) in spans and eval logs for correlation.
rachelle: ops-bot: deploying scorer-adapter-hotreload v0.3 -> staging :rocket:
ops-bot: staging passed, canary run scheduled 02:00 UTC.
chris: rollout: default to compiled. tenant override attaches runtime adapter behind sampling (start 1%). increase after eval pass.
ade: define evals: small prompt set + similarity metrics + latency p99 budgets.
samir: harness plan: run 1k queries sandboxed vs baseline, compute similarity and latency delta. alert if quality drops >2% or p99 increases >20ms.
mari: ops concern: many adapters concurrently -> OOM. admission control + LRU eviction needed.
piotr: config sketch: scorer_pool.max_adapters=500, eviction_policy=lru, cold_start=prewarm_on_probe.
ade: also auto-fallback to compiled scorer if adapter times out or crashes, increment fallback counters.
rachelle: action items: chris draft RFC for hybrid scorer runtime + adapter API; samir+mari prototype eval harness; piotr+ade add fingerprint telemetry; ops add admission knobs and alerts.
chris: plan small canary with 3 tenants after RFC and harness.
ade: I'll draft RFC today, include config sketch & canary checklist.
samir: prototyping harness this week.
mari: running memory sims and p99 tests.
piotr: documenting span schema for adapter fingerprint.
rachelle: ops will prep alerts for adapter OOM, high fallback rate.
ade: interim decision: adopt hybrid approach - compiled default, runtime adapters allowed under strict admission & eval gates. moving to RFC channel when draft ready. :white_check_mark:
